needs.reason: Every declared version is literal except kotlin-test, whose version is the Kotlin plugin's (2.0.21). The source set integrationTest and its task are declared in the script but are plain to read; only the evaluated model lists the derived configurations and tasks.

traps: integrationTest is a third source set: its sources are in src/integrationTest/kotlin, compiled by compileIntegrationTestKotlin and run by the task integrationTest, which check depends on. A reader that knows only main and test misses it.
integrationTest sees main through compileClasspath += main.output, not through a project dependency, and inherits testImplementation (kotlin-test) through extendsFrom.
kotlin("test") carries no version: the Kotlin Gradle plugin aligns it to 2.0.21 and, because the test tasks use the JUnit Platform, also adds kotlin-test-junit5, which pulls JUnit Jupiter.
The plugin adds org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib 2.0.21 to implementation without any line in the build file; it is not a declared dependency.
The Kotlin compiler version is the plugin version 2.0.21: Gradle downloads it, so it is a build dependency, not a toolchain. jvmToolchain(21) is the JDK for both the Kotlin and the Java compilation.
Each Kotlin source set also has a java directory (src/main/java and so on) that does not exist on disk.
